# Template: lorenz_curve
A Lorenz curve: cumulative share of income against cumulative share of the population, the 45-degree line of perfect equality, the sagging Lorenz curve, the shaded area between them whose relative size IS the Gini coefficient (printed as a caption), and an optional second curve for comparing two countries or years. Choose this scene for ANY request about inequality, the Lorenz curve, the Gini coefficient or index, income or wealth distribution shares, "the top X% own Y%", or comparing inequality between countries or over time.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "gini": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Gini coefficient of the main curve, 0.05-0.85 (default 0.4)."
  },
  "compare_gini": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Optional second curve's Gini, for comparison (dashed)."
  },
  "labels": {
   "type": "array",
   "minItems": 2,
   "maxItems": 2,
   "items": {
    "type": "string"
   },
   "description": "Names for [main, comparison] curves when comparing (e.g. [\"Norway\", \"Brazil\"])."
  },
  "shade": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Shade the Gini area between equality and the main curve (default true)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- axes: the coordinate axes (a group with captions)
- equality: the 45-degree line of perfect equality
- lorenz: the main Lorenz curve
- lorenz2: the comparison curve (dashed, when compare_gini)
- gini_area: the shaded area between equality and the main curve (when shade)
- gini_caption: "Gini = 0.40" printed under the curve
- label_equality: caption on the equality line
- label_lorenz: caption on the main curve (label_lorenz2 for the comparison)
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw a Lorenz curve and show what the Gini coefficient measures." → params: {"title":"The Lorenz curve"}
Request: "Compare inequality in two countries with Lorenz curves." → params: {"gini":0.27,"compare_gini":0.53,"labels":["Norway","Brazil"],"title":"Two countries, two curves"}

In YAML: `template: lorenz_curve` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
